title: Learn the campaign and return to entry
description: A new visitor reads each field-guide chapter, keeps keyboard focus through navigation, and returns without signing in or changing a campaign.

steps.description: The visitor arrives at Cluster and can choose Play or Learn.
steps.acknowledgement: The production entry surface is ready for input.
verifications: Learn is available and no private campaign or commander is shown.

steps.description: The visitor opens Learn with the keyboard and reads the purpose of alliances.
steps.acknowledgement: The first chapter heading receives focus.
verifications: The next chapter and return controls are available.

steps.description: The visitor reads “Two fronts. One system.”.
steps.acknowledgement: The chapter “Two fronts. One system.” is visible and focused.
verifications: The guide remains a readable bounded surface with a return control.

steps.description: The visitor reads “Build the means to prevail”.
steps.acknowledgement: The chapter “Build the means to prevail” is visible and focused.
verifications: The guide remains a readable bounded surface with a return control.

steps.acknowledgement: The chapter “Information is influence” is visible and focused.
verifications: The guide remains a readable bounded surface with a return control.

steps.description: The visitor closes Learn and returns to its opening control.
verifications: Play is still available; learning did not sign in or create a campaign.
